curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When a toddler escapes a corporate lab determined to free his peers, can the scientists track him down before their secret unravels?
curatedMovie.description: At BabyCo, researchers secretly work to decode toddler speech, believing it holds universal secrets. When a brilliant infant named Sly slips out of confinement, he sets out to organize a rescue for those left behind.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Light, comedic, and easy to follow, balancing family-friendly antics with a brisk, sci-fi-tinged pursuit.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Bob Clark blends sci-fi intrigue with lighthearted family comedy, delivering a playful chase driven by quick-witted infants outsmarting adults.
